editorial.blurb: Bai Ordo brings authentic Central Asian flavors and generous portions to a warm, welcoming dining room where the hospitality feels as genuine as the food tastes.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask for less salt if you prefer, and go with a group on a quieter weeknight to fully appreciate the calm, attentive service—or request the special menu for a unique blend of Mediterranean and Central Asian dishes.

topDishes.note: Hearty and aromatic with lovely lamb-and-dill flavor, perfect cold-weather comfort
Served with beef slices and carrots; generous portions, well-flavored and satisfying
Fried lamb and potatoes; very tasty with authentic Central Asian preparation
